title: The Salt Pans
text: Shallow pans of salt shine white to the horizon, crusted and glittering, raked into neat rows by hands that are nowhere to be seen. Inland, salt is gold. Somewhere out on the flats, the salt-keepers are watching their pans.

options.label: Rake as much salt as you can carry.

outcomes.text: The work is heavy and so are the packs. By morning, the rows behind you have been raked smooth again.

options.label: The slowest stays back to watch for the salt-keepers while the rest rake.

outcomes.text: They see the keepers coming, and you leave in time.

options.label: The shrewdest trades with the salt-keepers rather than steal from them.

outcomes.text: They trade salt for iron, fairly, with hands that are very dry.
